scenes.subject_block: a single seamless full-bleed inked graphic-novel panel, bold black linework, still and vast: a wide desert night beneath a black sky heavy with storm cloud, a distant wilderness camp of goat-hair tents just visible on the horizon, a single tall wooden pole standing far off with something small and still atop it, barely visible in the darkness, the whole land silent and waiting; the object never held power, only the One who commanded the looking; grave, hushed, one continuous image, no frame, no panels, no border, no text
scenes.atmos: heavy dark storm clouds, faint starlight breaking through at the edges

cap.text: The bronze never had power; God did. Looking was never magic, it was trust.

scenes.title: His own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree
scenes.subject_block: a single seamless full-bleed inked graphic-novel panel, bold black linework, grave and weighty: Christ hangs crucified on a wooden cross against a darkened storm sky, head bowed low as if under an unseen crushing weight, both arms outstretched, each bare wrist pressed flat against the plain wood with clean skin visible all around it, a single flat button-sized iron nail head lying flush against the centre of each wrist, a thin trickle of blood below each nail, plain wood grain touching skin directly on every other side of the wrist, blood only at the small nail wound itself, wearing a simple cream-white robe covering his torso and both shoulders down to the elbows, NOT bare-chested, NOT shirtless, NOT stripped, fully clothed in the robe, the weight of the world silently borne; solemn, heavy, one continuous image, no frame, no panels, no border, no text

scenes.title: He lifted His Son on a cross for exactly that
scenes.subject_block: a single seamless full-bleed inked graphic-novel panel, bold black linework, wide and reverent establishing view: three wooden crosses stand atop a rocky hill against a wide evening sky, the centre cross catching a break of golden light through dark clouds, the two outer crosses in deep shadow, seen from a respectful distance below across bare rock and scattered stones; grave, majestic, one continuous image, no frame, no panels, no border, no text

cap.text: He lifted His Son on a cross for exactly that, so that whosoever turns their eyes to Him
